image_title: Tool Verification for Test-Time Reinforcement Learning
summary: This image presents a visual representation of the concept of T²RL (Tool Verification for Test-Time Reinforcement Learning), highlighting the process of verifying pseudo-labels through majority voting. It includes a table with sampled predictions (A, B, C), estimated rewards (0, 1), and verification results indicating skewed and reliable outcomes. The chart also displays relative accuracy gains across various math difficulties (MATH-500, AMC, and AIME), showing improvements from T²RL compared to traditional methods. The average accuracy gains are noted as 17.1% for AIME, 7.8% for AMC, and 6.3% for MATH-500, emphasizing T²RL's effectiveness in stabilizing self-evolution in reinforcement learning.
